title: PoETa v2: Toward More Robust Evaluation of Large Language Models in Portuguese

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model performance on a subset of BIG-Bench tasks translated into Portuguese versus their original English versions to quantify performance disparities caused by language representation.

Using the translated BBQ (Bias Benchmark for QA) dataset to evaluate whether models rely on stereotypes against protected categories (such as age or nationality) when answering ambiguous multiple-choice questions.
Evaluating the model's ability to identify hate speech and offensive internet comments specifically directed at women using the MINA-BR dataset.

Assessing model performance on natively developed Brazilian Portuguese tasks (such as local university exams, proverbs, and colloquial expressions) to evaluate the capture of regional knowledge and cultural nuance.
